releaseNotes:
Live TV: when a channel's picture freezes or the sound drops, the app now notices and reconnects by itself. The channel that kept losing its sound (ECU: El Canal del Futbol) now plays with steady sound.

Subtitles: movies and episodes that have their own subtitles now show them first, under "Subtitles in this file" - always in sync. Online subtitles stay in step with the video, and the sync buttons move exactly what they say (-1s, -0.25s, +0.25s, +1s).

Player settings on a phone held upright: they open under the picture so you can still watch it, and you can drag them down to close.
